name: React Bits
summary: Open-source library of 200+ animated React components: text effects, backgrounds, UI pieces and micro interactions.
description: Animated, interactive React components installed as source you own, organised into text animations, animations, components, backgrounds and micro interactions — from text effects and WebGL backgrounds to carousels, cards, toasts and agent-UI widgets. Each ships in four variants (JS/TS × CSS/Tailwind) and installs via the shadcn or jsrepo CLI or copy-paste; React Bits Pro adds premium components, blocks and templates.
contains: categories: text animations, animations, components, backgrounds, micro interactions
4 variants per component: JS/TS × plain CSS/Tailwind
install via shadcn or jsrepo CLI, or copy the source
free creative tools: Background Studio, Shape Magic, Texture Lab
React Bits Pro adds premium components, page blocks, app UI and templates
official ports for Vue (vue-bits.dev) and Svelte (sveltebits.xyz)
